title: Birol et al. (2002) Penicillin production in a fed-batch fermentor (extended Bajpai and Reuss model)
equations_note: The paper states the model: 'differential Eqs. (1), (3), (9)-(18) that are solved simultaneously' (section 2.10). Left out: eq 2 (the original Bajpai-Reuss growth rate, replaced by eq 3), eqs 4 and 7 (proportionality statements explaining the terms of eq 3, no '='), eqs 5-6 ([H+] dynamics under pH control; not in the paper's own list, so [H+] is an input here), eq 8 (the PID controller, not the process).
